query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Build and update a knowledge base from public video transcript data, mark incomplete archive documents when transcript retrieval failed, and append summarized entries to existing Google Docs.
query_ground_truth.intent: This query searches for a tool capable of adding summarized content entries to existing Google Docs.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Step]: Locate the target document by exact/near title using GOOGLEDOCS_SEARCH_DOCUMENTS (capture doc_id; if multiple matches, confirm the intended document before writing).

[Optional (if no doc found)] [Step]: Create the document using GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT_MARKDOWN (seed with a minimal Markdown header/section; if content has multiple tables, create with the first portion only).
[Optional (if you need precise placement/indices)] [Prerequisite]: Load document structure using GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_BY_ID (identify insertion point and avoid manual index guesswork).

[Required] [Step]: Append or update the formatted report section using GOOGLEDOCS_UPDATE_DOCUMENT_SECTION_MARKDOWN (provide Markdown; omit start_index only when intentionally appending; split into multiple calls if needed to fit Markdown constraints).
[Optional (if Markdown section update fails or formatting is incompatible)] [Fallback]: Append plain text using GOOGLEDOCS_INSERT_TEXT_ACTION (set append_to_end=true to avoid index math).
[Optional (if a PDF deliverable is required)] [Next Step]: Export the final doc using GOOGLEDOCS_EXPORT_DOCUMENT_AS_PDF.
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLEDOCS_SEARCH_DOCUMENTS] Title searches can return multiple candidates; selecting the wrong doc_id causes miswrites—confirm before updating.
[GOOGLEDOCS_SEARCH_DOCUMENTS] Results may be empty (e.g., empty files list); handle by creating the document instead of assuming failure.
[GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT_MARKDOWN] Validation can fail if markdown_text includes multiple tables; keep to one table per call and append the remainder later.
[GOOGLEDOCS_UPDATE_DOCUMENT_SECTION_MARKDOWN] If start_index is omitted, the tool appends to the end; reruns can duplicate sections if not accounted for.
[GOOGLEDOCS_INSERT_TEXT_ACTION] Plain-text fallback can lose intended Markdown formatting; use only when section-Markdown updates are unsuitable.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Google Docs is a cloud-based word processor with real-time collaboration, version history, and integration with other Google Workspace apps
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=googledocs. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="googledocs") to create a connection BEFORE executing any googledocs tools.

GOOGLEDOCS_SEARCH_DOCUMENTS.description: Search for Google Documents using various filters including name, content, date ranges, and more.

query.description: Search query to filter documents. Provide either: (1) Plain text to search in document content (e.g., 'quarterly report'), which will search fullText, or (2) Drive API query syntax with operators like 'name contains', 'fullText contains', combined with 'and', 'or', 'not'. Leave empty to get all documents.

order_by.description: Order results by field. Common options: 'modifiedTime desc', 'modifiedTime asc', 'name', 'createdTime desc'

page_token.description: Token for continuing a previous search request on the next page. Use the next_page_token from the previous response to retrieve additional results.

max_results.description: Maximum number of documents to return per page (1-100). Defaults to 10. Use page_token for pagination when more results are available.

starred_only.description: Whether to return only starred documents. Defaults to False.

created_after.description: Return documents created after this date. Use RFC 3339 format like '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

modified_after.description: Return documents modified after this date. Use RFC 3339 format like '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

shared_with_me.description: Whether to return only documents shared with the current user. Defaults to False.

include_trashed.description: Whether to include documents in trash. Defaults to False.

response_detail.description: Level of detail in the response. 'minimal' returns only essential fields (id, name, modifiedTime, webViewLink) for efficient token usage. 'full' returns comprehensive metadata including permissions, owners, timestamps, and other detailed information.

include_shared_drives.description: Whether to include documents from shared drives you have access to. Defaults to True.

GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT_MARKDOWN.description: Creates a new Google Docs document, optionally initializing it with a title and content provided as Markdown text.

title.description: The title for the new Google Docs document.

name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service

s3key.description: The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service.

mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file

file.description: Uploaded image file. The action converts it into a temporary public URL that Google Docs can fetch.

name.description: Name used to reference the uploaded image from Markdown, for example attachment://diagram or ./diagram.png.

image_assets.description: Optional uploaded images that Markdown can reference by name. Use Markdown image syntax like ![Alt](attachment://diagram). Public HTTPS image URLs in markdown do not need image_assets.

markdown_text.description: The initial content for the document, formatted as Markdown. Also accepts 'content' as an alias. Supports headings, real Google Docs lists including nested lists, multiple Markdown tables, task-list markers, images via publicly accessible URLs or matching image_assets uploads (max 2KB URL length after resolution; formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF; SVG not supported), blockquotes, code blocks, hyperlinks (e.g., [text](url)), and text formatting (bold, italic, etc.). If empty or omitted, creates document with title only.

GOOGLEDOCS_UPDATE_DOCUMENT_SECTION_MARKD.description: Tool to insert or replace a section of a Google Docs document with Markdown content. Use when you need to update only a section of a document by specifying start and optional end indices. Supports full Markdown formatting.

tab_id.description: Optional tab ID to update with the rendered Markdown. When omitted, the first tab is updated.

end_index.description: Optional one-based end index of the content to replace (exclusive); must be greater than or equal to start_index. If end_index is not provided, the content is inserted at the start_index without replacing existing content. Requires start_index to be provided - if start_index is omitted (append mode), end_index is ignored. Important: Use the exact indices from GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_BY_ID without modification. The Google Docs API does not allow deleting the last newline character of a document segment (body, header, footer, etc.), so ensure end_index does not include the final segment newline.

document_id.description: The unique ID of the Google Docs document to update. This is the alphanumeric string found in the document URL: https://docs.google.com/document/d/{DOCUMENT_ID}/edit. Valid IDs are typically 44 characters long and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores (e.g., '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms'). To get a document ID: create a new document using GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT, or extract it from an existing document's URL. Also accepts parameter aliases: 'id', 'doc_id', 'documentId', or 'docId'.

start_index.description: One-based UTF-16 code unit index where to insert or start replacement. If not provided, content will be appended to the end of the document. Use 1 to insert at the very beginning of the document. To insert at a specific position, first use GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_BY_ID to retrieve the document structure and find the desired index from the body.content elements' start_index/end_index values. If the provided index equals or exceeds the document segment's end index, it will be automatically adjusted to the last valid position (end_index - 1) and a message will be included in the response.

markdown_text.description: Markdown content to insert or replace in the document section. Large content is automatically split into smaller batches to avoid API limits. Also accepts 'markdown', 'content', 'text', 'body', 'markdownText', or 'markdown_content'.

GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_BY_ID.description: Retrieves an existing Google Document by its ID; will error if the document is not found.

id.description: The unique identifier for a native Google Docs document (typically a 44-character alphanumeric string). Accepts either a document ID or a full Google Docs URL (e.g., https://docs.google.com/document/d/{DOCUMENT_ID}/edit). When a URL is provided, the document ID will be automatically extracted. IMPORTANT: This tool only works with native Google Docs documents (mimeType application/vnd.google-apps.document), not uploaded Office files (DOCX, XLSX, etc.) stored in Google Drive. Use GOOGLEDOCS_SEARCH_DOCUMENTS to find available documents.

includeTabsContent.description: When true, request includeTabsContent=true so the response includes document.tabs with content for all tabs. When false, Google Docs returns the legacy first-tab content fields.
